prior_summary: Event progress with elastic duration: a two-observation recurrent belief predicts ordered manipulation events, within-event progress, positive nominal and remaining durations, and uncertainty. A learned progress-knot action reference is time-decoded, and a progress-resampled temporal diffusion denoiser is pulled back to physical action timestamps. A separate persistent gripper head conditions a direct-time gripper diffusion score.
applicable_conditions: Use throughout the assigned expanded deliver_disengage slices: low open approach, closure, partial lift, elevated transport, descent, release lag, retreat, and nonterminal high next approach or terminal settling. Assumes the observed red-then-blue order, world-frame state channels and comparable 20 Hz control/contact response. Two real consecutive observations are preferable; no stationary-entry requirement. The fixed interface lacks role IDs and past commands, so roles and command persistence are learned from object-goal geometry, TCP relation, finger apertures, qpos and qvel.
termination_guidance: Continue through placement and release when useful, using measured finger opening, object separation and TCP motion to distinguish release from retreat. A nonterminal outgoing overlap can be transferred while moving toward the next block; the successor must be able to finish predecessor completion if called earlier during descent or release. Terminal settling is learned but is not an additional task-success condition. Evaluate the supplied one-observation rotated-containment and height contract separately; release, clearance and zero velocity are not required by that contract.
limitations: Local masked windows cannot supply full offline phase alignments or uncensored complete-phase durations. Training uses soft local event labels, geometric progress proxies, observed within-phase rates and right-censored remaining-time labels. The recurrent state spans only two observations; repeated indistinguishable dwell states cannot reveal a hidden expert clock. Role reconstruction is specialized to observed red-then-blue demonstrations, not arbitrary nominated roles. Progress warping is a learned denoiser feature transformation, not a change to the fixed DDPM noise law. No IK, FK, image encoder, geometric invariance, hard contact/placement constraint, recovery controller or calibrated timeout is implemented. Interface checks do not establish task performance or the duration-elastic hypothesis.

config.data_scope: All 24 assigned expanded slices without trimming or resegmentation, including all incoming and outgoing overlaps
config.normalization: Shared complete-original-demonstration limits normalizer supplied in spec; no per-skill fitting
config.backbone: Public conditional temporal U-Net, widths 128/256/512, 450-dimensional causal condition
config.duration_supervision: Observed first advancing phase boundary in local future; no observed boundary gives a lower-bound censoring penalty. Nominal durations use masked positive within-phase progress rates.
proposed_not_executed_ablations: benign temporal resampling only with rescaled qvel and duration labels
